data_availability_corrected_at: 2026-07-24 before any return panel or report was constructed; the configured Alpaca IEX account returned no bars before 2020-07-28
hypothesis: For a liquid U.S. stock with a premarket SEC Item 2.02 disclosure, a positive stock-minus-SPY return during the first 30 regular-session minutes continues from a deliberately delayed 10:05 ET entry through a 15:55 ET exit after conservative retail costs.

event.duplicate_policy: one event per symbol and session; retain earliest SEC acceptance

universe.known_limitation: Static current-active large-cap universe has survivorship and historical-identifier bias. A pass can justify better data, not paper or live promotion.

data.event_source: official SEC submissions JSON normalized by data.sec_filings
data.venue_limitation: IEX is venue-local and does not represent consolidated SIP/NBBO execution.

signal.stock_reaction: 09:55 five-minute bar close divided by 09:30 five-minute bar open minus one

trading_rule.entry: 10:05 ET five-minute bar open, after the 10:00 signal boundary
trading_rule.exit: 15:55 ET five-minute bar open, leaving the strategy flat for the final bar
trading_rule.daily_portfolio: equal weight across all selected names in the session

costs.cost_application: subtract one stock round trip from each selected event; SPY is a diagnostic benchmark and is not traded
costs.impact_note: The scout reports fixed and stressed costs. Promotion-quality work must add account-size-specific spread and ADV participation impact using point-in-time SIP and liquidity data.

reserved_forward_period.policy: Do not use for rule selection. Preserve for later unchanged-specification confirmation or forward operation.

prohibited_rescue_variants: earnings-surprise, analyst, sentiment, VWAP, sector, or market-regime filter
different signal, entry, or exit clock
stop loss, profit target, trailing stop, or re-entry
holdout_policy: Do not download or evaluate a later partition unless every preceding partition passes every unchanged gate. A failed partition terminates this exact branch. A pass remains a bounded IEX/static-universe scout and does not authorize paper or live trading.
